buildCommand: node scripts/sync-transactions.js && node scripts/update-sw-version.js && next build
ignoreCommand: git log -1 --format=%B | grep -qE '\[(skip ci|vercel skip)\]' || { B=$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA; [ "$B" != "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ] && git cat-file -e "$B^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || B=HEAD^; git diff --quiet "$B" HEAD ./ 2>/dev/null || exit 1; }
